title: Agentforce Sales Coach: What Salesforce Offers and Where Practice Tools Fit
summary: What Agentforce Sales Coach does in October 2026: role-play, pitch feedback, setup, editions and billing, and where a practice tool fits for Salesforce teams.
body_markdown:
What to test


How to run it


Score 0, 1 or 2


Setup time


Time from kickoff to the first assigned scenario, including admin work.


0 if more than two weeks, 2 if within a few days


Buyer pushback


Two senior reps run the negotiation scenario and rate whether the buyer resisted like a real one.


0 if the buyer folds, 2 if reps say it matched


Voice


Run a full spoken role-play, not a typed one.


0 if typed only, 2 if spoken with natural turn-taking


Your criteria


Load your own stage criteria and check that feedback cites the moment behind each score.


0 if generic, 2 if your criteria with evidence


Retry one moment


Ask the rep to replay only the pricing or objection moment.


0 if full restart only, 2 if they can start at the moment


Call format


Run the call you sell: a committee call, a technical demo with a shared screen, a renewal.


0 if not supported, 2 if it runs as sold


Real-call link


Score the same behavior on each rep's next real call.


0 if no change, 2 if the miss is gone on most calls


Cost


Get a written quote, including metered conversations and Data 360.


0 if usage cost is unknown, 2 if fixed and in budget
